This API endpoint can be used to initiate an automated process for inviting a tenant who is identified by their unique tenant_id .

Arthur Tenants API - the tenants surface of the Arthur API v2, the UK property management platform from Arthur Online (an Aareon company). Derived operation-for-operation from the provider's public Postman Documenter collection at https://developer.arthuronline.co.uk/. Every request is scoped to an Arthur entity via the mandatory X-EntityID header and authorised with an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code access token.
